candidate: <commit, range or tree identity; an audit reference, not the reuse key>

identity.project: <project-issued: which project or repository this evidence covers>
identity.contentIdentity: <project-issued: the actual input set - in-scope content, deletions, untracked files, relevant callers, contracts and fixtures; for a review also scoped comparison-base content and scope mode>
identity.dependencyIdentity: <project-issued: the configuration, rules, selector, toolchain and check commands this run used>
identity.environment: <project-issued: a stable execution profile or target, not a machine nickname>

checks.detail: <skip reason or link to native report; omit behavior for lint, type and docs checks>

definition.test: <versioned test path and case, or repeatable scenario definition>

behavior.inputs: <material parameters; safe references, never raw credentials>

assertions.nativeCase: <executed case/result locator in the native report; actual values only if captured>

attachments: <relevant native case evidence, or omit when none is needed>

baseline.before: <entries or count in the committed baseline>
baseline.new: <entries the candidate added; a pass needs 0>
baseline.stale: <entries the candidate fixed and the baseline dropped>

deselected: <checks or profiles considered and left out, and why>
outcome: <qualified for the selected scope | not qualified>
nextRequiredAction: <the broader check, review or delivery step still needed>
